question: Which of the following expansion valves functions to maintain a constant pressure in the evaporator?
solution:
The correct answer is __Automatic Expansion Valve**(AEV)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Automatic expansion valve__ is abbreviated as AEV.
 
• The primary function of an AEV is to maintain a constant pressure in the evaporator.
 
• It is primarily used in refrigeration and air conditioning systems.
 
• The valve operates by regulating the flow of refrigerant into the evaporator based on the pressure inside it.
 
• Unlike thermostatic or electronic expansion valves, the AEV does not respond to temperature changes.
 
• The AEV is best suited for systems with stable and steady load conditions.
 
• It is not recommended for systems with frequent load variations as it lacks the flexibility to adapt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Thermostatic Expansion Valve:**

 
 
• It controls the flow of refrigerant into the evaporator based on the temperature at the evaporator outlet.
 
• It ensures efficient heat transfer and prevents liquid refrigerant from entering the compressor.
 
 
 
• **Electronic Expansion Valve: **
 
 
• It uses electronic sensors and controls for precise regulation of refrigerant flow.
 
• It provides better efficiency and adaptability in variable load conditions.
 
 
 
• **Level Master Control:**
 
 
• It is used to maintain the liquid level in evaporators or other components of a refrigeration system.
 
• It is not designed to regulate pressure or temperature like expansion valves.
